第22章 柳暗花明又一村-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

寸头男人推开门，侧了下身让顾承安先进去，然后自己了退出去，把门带上了。

全程没有多说一个字。

办公室不大，大概二十平米。一张办公桌，一把椅子，一组文件柜，一台电脑。桌上摆着一盆绿萝和一个面包。

桌后的人，看起来四十出头，中等身材，方脸，戴着一副银框眼镜，穿了件浅灰色POlO衫，头发梳得整齐但不油腻。

长相普通，放在人堆里绝对找不出来的那种，甚至比寸头司机还不起眼。

“坐吧，不要拘束。”

男人指了指桌前的椅子。

顾承安乖乖坐下，要不是对系统的绝对信任。

他都要怀疑真实性了。

男人起身走到一旁，打开一个柜子，拿出一瓶矿泉水，给他。

“路上还顺利吗？”

“顺利。”

“吃了没？”

“飞机上吃了个三明治。”顾承安老老实实交代。

“那玩意能叫吃？”男人笑了一下，把面包袋往他那边推了推，“先垫垫。”

这个开场跟顾承安预想的完全不一样。

他本以为会是某种严肃的、充满仪式感的对话——欢迎加入组织、你已经正式转正、国家需要你之类的台词。

结果是一包面包和一句吃了没。

“谢了。”顾承安没客气，撕了一块下来吃。确实饿了，飞机上那个三明治塞牙缝都不够。

男人看他吃了两口，才开口。

“自我介绍一下，我叫温良，第三处现任处长。”

说完他停顿了一下。

“你之前一直联系的那个春风，是我的代号。”

春风。

是他。

顾承安回忆了一下此前几次通讯的内容。措辞简洁，指令清楚，回复很快，从不多说半个字的废话。他一直以为那头是个更年长、更严肃的人。

没想到是面前这位看上去像中学教务主任的男人。

“明白了。”顾承安点头。

温良摘下眼镜擦了擦镜片，重新戴上。

The short-haired man opened the door, leaned down to let Gu Chengan go in first, then exited and closed the door.

Not a single word was said the whole time.

The office is not big, about twenty square meters.A desk, a chair, a set of filing cabinets, and a computer.There is a pot of pothos and a piece of bread on the table.

The man behind the desk looked to be in his early forties, with a medium build and a square face. He was wearing a pair of silver-rimmed glasses and a light gray Polo shirt. His hair was neatly combed but not greasy.

He is an ordinary-looking person who would never be found in a crowd. He is even more inconspicuous than a short-haired driver.

"Sit down and don't be restrained."

The man pointed to the chair in front of the table.

Gu Chengan sat down obediently, but for his absolute trust in the system.

He almost doubted the authenticity.

The man stood up and walked aside, opened a cabinet, took out a bottle of mineral water and gave it to him.

"How's the journey going?"

"Smooth."

"Have you eaten?"

"I had a sandwich on the plane." Gu Chengan said honestly.

"Can that thing be eaten?" The man smiled and pushed the bread bag towards him, "First, give it a cushion."

This opening was completely different from what Gu Chengan expected.

He originally expected it to be some kind of serious, ceremonial dialogue - lines such as welcome to the organization, you have officially become a regular member, and the country needs you.

The result was a bag of bread and a question of whether you had eaten.

"Thank you." Gu Chengan was polite and tore off a piece and ate it.I am really hungry, and the sandwich on the plane is not even enough to fit between my teeth.

The man watched him take two bites before speaking.

"Let me introduce myself. My name is Wen Liang, the current director of the Third Division."

After speaking he paused.

"The Chunfeng you have been in contact with before is my code name."

Spring breeze.

It's him.

Gu Chengan recalled the contents of the previous communications.The wording is concise, the instructions are clear, the replies are quick, and there is never a word of nonsense.He always thought it was an older, more serious man on the other end.

Unexpectedly, it was the man in front of me who looked like the academic dean of a middle school.

"I understand." Gu Chengan nodded.

Wen Liang took off his glasses, wiped the lenses, and put them back on.
